method: Scripts assembled from verified record fields only; no generative prose. Sourced summary sentences are quoted from the cited article. Narration is machine-synthesised and disclosed as such in the UI.

blocked.label: Assamese

blocked.label: Dzongkha
blocked.blocker: No Dzongkha speech voice is available, and this project has no Dzongkha speaker to review a translation. Publishing unreviewed Dzongkha narration about Buddhist practice would risk exactly the kind of error this archive exists to avoid.

durationNote: Scripts are composed from a fixed template plus verified per-site facts, so every language lands inside the 60-90 second window by construction.
